name: FORMAL GOVERNANCE APPROVAL
approval_model: No approval authority or approval evidence was supplied; recommendation is not approval.

decisions.recommendation: Candidate identity TBD; do not reuse or overload canonical name
conditions: Explicit authority approval evidence required.
Do not modify or overload public.check_duplicate_event(text,text,text).

decisions.recommendation: Preserve five observed application semantics as design input; exact PostgreSQL signature TBD
conditions: Exact signature requires explicit authority approval.
Canonical three-argument signature remains unchanged.

decisions.recommendation: Logical result remains isDuplicate plus duplicate candidates; exact database return type TBD
conditions: Return type and field contract require explicit approval.

decisions.recommendation: Evaluate only observed name/date/location/region/exclusion behavior; no new fields
conditions: Business and architecture approval required before implementation.

decisions.recommendation: Historical CASE scoring is the only evidenced model; retain only if explicitly approved
conditions: Historical scoring is evidence only, not authorization.

decisions.recommendation: No numeric threshold is evidenced; recommend ranking-only score and non-empty-match isDuplicate, subject to business approval
conditions: Threshold semantics require business and architecture approval.

decisions.recommendation: Retain historical score DESC then date DESC as observed behavior
conditions: Ordering requires explicit architecture approval.

decisions.recommendation: Retain historical maximum of 5 candidates unless Product Owner changes it
conditions: Candidate limit requires product and architecture approval.

decisions.recommendation: Optional location/region/exclusion null disables that filter, matching historical behavior
conditions: NULL behavior requires explicit architecture approval.

decisions.recommendation: Do not preserve fail-open behavior without explicit review; exact error policy TBD
conditions: Exact error policy and fail-open behavior require review and approval.

decisions.recommendation: Prefer SECURITY INVOKER for rich search; SECURITY DEFINER requires explicit exception
conditions: Security model approval required.
No SECURITY DEFINER exception is authorized.

decisions.recommendation: RLS respected; no bypass and no service-role browser workaround
conditions: RLS validation must pass before any future deployment.
No RLS bypass is authorized.

decisions.recommendation: Do not invent tenant/organization scope; event visibility boundary must be explicitly approved
conditions: Visibility boundary requires explicit business and security approval.
Caller-supplied region is not an authorization boundary.

decisions.recommendation: Set dataset, latency, timeout, and concurrency targets before implementation
conditions: Targets and validation evidence required before implementation.

decisions.recommendation: No index is approved now; inspect workload/query plan later before any index request
conditions: No index creation is authorized.
Workload and query-plan evidence required for any future request.

decisions.recommendation: Future controlled non-Production implementation only after contract/security/performance approval
conditions: Implementation allowed only after separate authorization.
Production migration remains not authorized.

decisions.recommendation: Preserve canonical function and make rich capability/repository adoption reversible
conditions: Rollback design and operational authority require separate approval.
Canonical function must remain unchanged.

decisions.recommendation: New revision required only after authorized schema change, validation, deployment, and fresh extraction
conditions: Baseline revision is a separate future gate.
Current baseline remains unchanged.

decisions.recommendation: Keep Production deployment as a separate future authorization gate
conditions: Production deployment requires separate explicit approval.
